fault: the invocation dying after a dispatch left and before its row is marked sent: crash_after on the dispatcher fetch, ambiguous on it, or the UPDATE that follows failing (crash_before or error on the D1 run; the seed decides which is found first); the re-run dispatches the row again
description: A reconciliation job on a Cron Trigger dispatches each pending row to an external service and marks it sent. A crash between the dispatch and the mark leaves the row pending, so the re-run the operator declared for failed ticks dispatches it a second time.
